summary:
Added the backend endpoint only.

- `src/CleanArchitecture.Contracts/Common/HealthResponse.cs` — `record HealthResponse(string Status)`, serialized camelCase as `{"status":"ok"}`.
- `src/CleanArchitecture.Api/Controllers/HealthController.cs` — `[Route("api/health")] [AllowAnonymous]` `GET` returning `Ok(new HealthResponse("ok"))`, following the existing `api/tutorials` route convention and `ApiController` base.
- `tests/.../Controllers/HealthControllerTests.cs` — integration test asserting 200 + `status == "ok"` anonymously.

Solution builds clean. The footer "API: ok" is Angular view work and belongs to the frontend repo (`realworld-app-angular-v20`); it consumes `GET /api/health`, which is already CORS-allowed for `http://localhost:4200`.
blockers: Not applied -- Show "API: ok" in the page footer: frontend view work — belongs to the separate Angular repository realworld-app-angular-v20

endpoints.purpose: Anonymous health check returning service status.

context_sharing.notes: The endpoint is anonymous ([AllowAnonymous] overriding the [Authorize] on the ApiController base) and returns 200 OK with a body whose Status value is the literal "ok"; JSON property casing is not explicitly configured in these files, so the wire name follows the host's default serializer settings (camelCase "status" under ASP.NET Core defaults).
